# agentic-crm

Small CRM for prospects, vendors, and leads on Cloudflare D1 and KV.

Keywords: crm, contacts, pipeline, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { MemoryCrmStore, createD1Store } from "agentic-crm".
- CLI: agentic-crm add-prospect --name "..." --email "...".
- MCP: run agentic-crm mcp, then call add_prospect.

## Docs
